listSubtitle: Transformations you are allowed to see, scoped by your role assignments.
created: Transformation created as a draft. It is not submitted or approved.
emptyBody: No transformation is visible to you. Access comes from role assignments at a scope.
emptyBodyCreate: Create the first transformation to start.
emptyFilteredBody: Change or clear the filters to see more results.

form.draftNote: A new transformation starts as a draft. Nothing is submitted or approved by creating it.
form.codeHint: Optional. Capital letters, digits, hyphen or underscore (for example TR-0100). Generated when left empty.

modeHelp.end_to_end: Runs every phase in order, from Diagnose to Realize.
modeHelp.modular: Starts at a chosen phase, for example to produce one standalone deliverable.

form.entryPhaseHint: The phase this transformation starts in.
form.deliverableHint: Optional: the single deliverable a modular engagement produces.
form.ownersHint: You can name yourself now; naming other people needs access to the user directory.
form.defaultHint: Leave empty to use the organization default: {{value}}.
form.noUnits: You cannot create transformations in any business unit. Ask an access administrator for a role at a business unit.
form.statusHint: Only the allowed next statuses are offered: draft → active; active → on hold or closed; on hold → active or closed.
form.lockedFields: Mode, entry phase and phase cannot be edited here: phase progression is controlled by stage gates.

workspace.title: Workspace summary
workspace.unknownNote: Unknown means the data does not exist yet. It is never shown as zero or as on track.

archive.title: Archive {{code}}
archive.description: Archiving keeps the record and its audit trail, but makes it read-only. It is not deleted.
archive.readOnly: Archived on {{when}}. This record is read-only.
archive.readOnlyShort: This transformation is archived and read-only.
